_about: One entry per option shown on the phone for every photo, in this order. crop: true = auto-crop around the subject (subject fills ~1/3 of the frame); false = the whole photo. style: settings for explore.py (hydrant technique + route order). Main knobs: Lmin = shortest stroke kept (higher = fewer, longer lines); target = how much line in total; flow = smoothing (higher = rounder, looser; lower = closer to the edges); arc_max = how wide the joins swing; scene = 1 adds a few background lines; avoid = 1 sends joins around dense areas. Options on the same image share the slow AI step, so each extra one costs ~5-8 s. ids: short and unique.
